title: Direct or Relay selection
content: Select one execution mode after target protocol is known: same protocol defaults to Direct; cross-protocol uses Relay; explicit configuration may force Relay for a same-protocol target. The client Front/SSE boundary does not choose the mode.

title: Relay request flow
content: Client JSON -> request Inbound lossless normalization -> Chat Process standard Chat semantic mapping or non-Chat extension governance and all Relay rewrites -> Outbound target-standard protocol projection -> provider-private Compat adjustment -> Provider wire and transport.

title: Relay response flow
content: Provider response -> full attempt buffer -> response Inbound lossless normalization -> response Chat Process with all Relay rewrites -> Outbound client-standard protocol projection -> committed client payload -> SSE client frame. Provider failure leaves the payload path and enters Error01-06.

title: Direct request and response flow
content: Client JSON -> same-protocol Direct decision -> registered Direct request hooks -> Provider transport relay. Provider response -> full attempt buffer -> registered Direct response hooks -> committed client payload -> SSE client frame. Direct does not enter Relay Chat Process for payload rewriting.

title: Error classification and projection
content: A source failure enters Error01-06 independently of request/response payloads. Internal request-stage failures project 598; internal response-stage failures project 599; network failures project 502; linked external failures preserve their real external status. Error projection never reconstructs control truth from client payloads and never wraps failure as success.
